title: Falling in Love
coreMove: The in-love high can open the door, but lasting love begins when open-eyed spouses choose disciplined care after the feeling stops carrying them.

exampleSpecs.audience: couples moving fast after a romantic surge
exampleSpecs.stakes: slow certainty enough for knowledge to catch up

exampleSpecs.audience: couples expecting intensity to sustain effort
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a time limit into preparation rather than panic
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Dorothy Tennov's limerence research makes romantic obsession time-limited

exampleSpecs.audience: partners defending a romance from every caution
exampleSpecs.stakes: let serious facts enter before commitments harden
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a mother's warning about five years in psychiatric care breaks through infatuation

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses afraid the missing rush means failure
exampleSpecs.stakes: replace panic with chosen care after the high fades
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two-year romantic obsession fading becomes a transition

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses waiting for affection to feel automatic again
exampleSpecs.stakes: meet emotional need after chemistry stops leading
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: real love chooses an act that fills the emotional tank

exampleSpecs.stakes: protect dignity by telling the truth before vows are planned
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: five years in psychiatric care must be known, not hidden by romance
